recommendation: Keep this fix as-is. It completes the FHIR-37907 terminology correction and removes the ambiguity left by the original application without changing cardinality, binding strength, or the value set.
issue_request: FHIR-37907 was a Published/Persuasive FM change request for ExplanationOfBenefit asking to update the priority description by changing the example code routine to normal for R5.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied implicitly in Paul Knapp's 2022-08-13 commit f952b5321d, which changed ExplanationOfBenefit.priority from "stat, routine deferred" to "stat, normal deferred" while also making nearby EOB updates. No commit mentioning FHIR-37907 was found, and the combined branch did not already contain an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for this issue.
additional_context: ExplanationOfBenefit is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/explanationofbenefit/structuredefinition-ExplanationOfBenefit.xml is in the current build. The existing EOB binding description and the parallel Claim.priority definition both list the process-priority examples as "stat, normal, deferred". Jira term search found only FHIR-37907, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no related discussion changing the conclusion.
reconciliation: Updated the authoritative ExplanationOfBenefit.priority definition to "stat, normal, deferred" and aligned the checked-in ExplanationOfBenefit SVG tooltip with that source text. The SVG change accompanies the independently necessary StructureDefinition source correction.
source_changes: source/explanationofbenefit/structuredefinition-ExplanationOfBenefit.xml: changed the priority definition examples from "stat, normal deferred" to "stat, normal, deferred".
source/explanationofbenefit/explanationofbenefit.svg: aligned the priority tooltip with the corrected definition text.
